headline: Approved pier at 12 Woodward Avenue and retaining wall at 6 River Road; approved peer review for 10 Gale Road and 40 Sargent Street.
summary: Members approved work at several sites, including 12 Woodward Avenue, 6 River Road, 2 Wallace Court, and 11 Old Salem Path. They approved peer reviews of the roadway and stormwater plan at 10 Gale Road and 40 Sargent Street and of the wetland delineation at 2 Beachland Avenue. Many other applications were continued to later dates.
